data.title: GitHub - BobClawblaw/bitcoinmachinecode: A working Bitcoin node implemented as 100% AI-generated x86-64 assembly (NASM). Every line of machine code was authored by an AI agent; C/Python serve only as verification oracles and test harnesses. Includes SHA-256, secp256k1 field/point/scalar/ECDSA-verify, P2P networking, block consensus, and a persistent-store node with headers-first IBD.
